Visited Seasons Restaurant on the way to the airport corridor and had a comfortable experience. The standout feature is definitely the massive internal parking space, making it a stress-free stop for travelers driving in. It's also super accessible with an auto stand right outside the premises. The restaurant is quite spacious and great for families. The portion sizes are very generous and offer excellent value for money. Highly recommend trying their special chicken curries, Biryani, or Chinese starters like Drums of Heaven if you have the time to sit and enjoy. Just keep in mind that service can be a bit relaxed during rush hours, so order early if you are rushing for a flight!

We recently placed a bulk order at this restaurant for our team of 15, planning ahead for a smooth evening dinner pickup after a long workday. I called a full day in advance to place the order, large varieties and generous quantities, including chicken biryani as the highlight, with portions calculated for 20 people to ensure everyone got plenty. We even followed up with another call 30 minutes before arriving, confirming we'd be there shortly. Despite all this foresight, we ended up waiting nearly an hour just to get our hands on the food. The staff seemed completely unprepared, scrambling around as if it was a last-minute walk-in.

To make matters worse, quality was shockingly subpar. Several chicken biryani packets arrived with zero chicken pieces, just plain rice pretending to be biryani. Portions across the board were laughably small; what was meant to feed 20 barely stretched to our group of 15, forcing us to supplement with cafeteria leftovers to avoid hungry teammates. The veg curries were drowned in watery gravy that tasted identical to the chicken gravy, no distinct flavors, just bland mush. They even swapped promised chicken dishes with random paneer, kaju, and vegetable kurma without a heads-up or apology, leaving us short on protein for a meat-heavy order.

Pricing felt like a total rip-off for such meager, disappointing quantities way overpriced compared to nearby spots that deliver reliably. Food taste? Strictly average at best, nothing memorable or crave-worthy. Service was the real dealbreaker: disorganized, unresponsive, and utterly poor from start to finish. Save your time, money, and frustration, plenty of better restaurants nearby nail bulk orders without the hassle. Won't be back, and I strongly advise steering clear. 1/5 stars.

reviews.author: R C
reviews.text:
Avoid at all costs.Absolutely Horrific Experience. My Child Got Food Poisoning + Filthy Conditions.

If I could leave zero stars, I would. Our visit to seasons on July 2025 was one of the worst dining experiences we’ve ever had and it ended with my child getting severe food poisoning within 5 hours she had only chicken Beriyani.
She suffered a lot with vomiting, diarrhea, high fever n sever stomach aches.This was clearly caused by contaminated chicken that she consumed In Beriyani.

And don’t even get me started on the condition of the women’s restroom — it was absolutely disgusting. Filthy toilets, literally feces and urine on floor and pungent stench.If the restroom is this unhygienic, I can only imagine what the kitchen looks like and seriously feel bad this restaurant workers .

This place is a health hazard, plain and simple. Strongly urge others to stay far away.

NO CHILD SHOULD SUFFER BECAUSE OF SUCH NEGLEGENCE..

reviews.text: This place is located at prime locations, but the one we visited for 10 minutes away from Bangalore airport. The chicken is Halal here so it was a plus point for me. We tried chicken noodles and sweet lassi both were 5/5 in taste and quality. They also serve Arabic and Mexican food which is a unique cuisine to find in the South. They have a clean washroom too. Must try sea food here.
